source_pipeline.pixel_lab: not used; no PixelLab asset was created for this pack, so there are no PixelLab object IDs to record
source_pipeline.rationale: The three formation elements exist to be told apart at a glance, and their silhouettes are the acceptance criterion. Generating them from committed geometry makes every frame reproducible byte-for-byte by re-running the forge, which a reviewer can verify directly. The accepted 256x256 weapon bursts stay the VFX channel and were not modified.

godot_import.filtering: nearest; the scene driver sets TEXTURE_FILTER_NEAREST so the forged pixel edges stay crisp

source_runtime_separation.source: 128x128 padded frame, the lossless master the forge writes
source_runtime_separation.runtime: alpha-trimmed crop of the same frame with 2px padding, no rescale, so no source pixel is lost

generator_provenance.pixellab_usage: engineer_sentry_wrench ships a new 9-frame transparent animation source generated through PixelLab MCP (create_1_direction_object + animate_object, FAN-2565); engineer_repair_drone and engineer_pressure_mines still use the deterministic in-repo geometry forge and generated no PixelLab asset

engineer_repair_drone.note: Forged element frame, unmodified by FAN-2565.

engineer_pressure_mines.note: Forged element frame, unmodified by FAN-2565.

weapons.title: Крепость за Секунду
weapons.silhouette: six tall narrow pylons with hexagonal turret heads standing on a fixed hexagon
weapons.motion_path: ground tap, six pylons rise in place on a fixed hexagon, crossfire holds, then the ring folds inward
weapons.timing_rhythm: shortest telegraph of the class, snap deployment, then the longest held crossfire
weapons.impact_language: synchronized muzzle volleys along the hex chords, then a shutdown vent

quality.reduced_motion_substitute: the six pylons hold their deployed frame with a steady lens glow instead of playing the firing cycle and the fold-out vent

assets.superseded_by: the FAN-2565 PixelLab deploy pack in assets/sprites/effects/ultimates/engineer/sentry_wrench_deploy; the forged frame below is still what engineer_ultimate_source_forge.gd emits and stays recorded so the forge output remains verifiable, but the sentry timeline no longer loads it
assets.role: superseded formation element for the hex crossfire; tall narrow pylon with a hexagonal turret head
assets.palette: pale mint and teal, matched to the accepted sentry wrench burst

assets.role: formation element for the double helix swarm; wide flat rotor bar over a small orb body
assets.palette: brass and gold with a magenta core, matched to the accepted repair drone burst

assets.role: formation element for the lattice mine field; squat prong-topped dome on a wide base plate
assets.palette: copper with a cyan proximity lens, matched to the accepted pressure mines burst

class_contact_sheet.layout: 15 columns x 3 rows. Columns are windup, release, active, recovery, cancel with 3 progress samples each; rows are engineer_sentry_wrench, engineer_repair_drone, engineer_pressure_mines.
class_contact_sheet.note: Composited from the same formation_points() and frame_index() the shipped scene driver calls, so the sheet is the motion and the frames the scene plays.

runtime_boundary.statement: The shared bridge still hardcodes VFX_SOURCE_PREFIX=res://assets/sprites/effects/vfx_weapon_ for both source_path and runtime_path, and this pack is forbidden to edit it. The class-local paths above are therefore declared and validated but not yet wired into live combat. Redirecting the shared runtime paths is unowned follow-up work recorded on FAN-1465; FAN-1541 owns the shared runtime adapter.
